attributes.name: Counter-Strike 2
attributes.description: CS2 dedicated server (SteamCMD auto-installed on create). Requires a GameTLS token from steamcommunity.com/dev/managegameservers for public lobbies - pass it as +sv_setsteamaccount in startup if needed.

installation.script:
apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq curl ca-certificates lib32gcc-s1 lib32stdc++6 > /dev/null
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar xzf steamcmd.tar.gz
rm -f steamcmd.tar.gz
./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /data +login anonymous +app_update 730 validate +quit
chmod +x /data/game/bin/linuxsteamrt64/cs2
